# How the runtime builds libuv (third_party/libuv, v1.53.0), from its CMakeLists.txt: each line
# names the systems it is for, `all`, `posix` (macOS and Linux), `macos`, `linux` or `windows`,
# then what it gives: a source file, a flag of the compiler or a library to link with.
all flag -fno-strict-aliasing
